ce_notes_excerpt: The IDccManSink::OnLogActive method is implemented by a client application and is called when a socket connection is established between the client application and Connection Manager. When this notification occurs, Connection Manager starts any applications that are registered with the registry key HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows CE Services\AutoStartOnConnect .

name: IDccManSink::OnLogDisconnection

ce_notes_excerpt: The IDccManSink::OnLogDisconnection method is implemented by a client application and is called when Cnnection Manager terminates the connection between the desktop computer and the target device. When this notification is made, Connection Manager starts any applications that are registered with the registry key HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows CE Services\AutoStartOnDisconnect .

name: IDccManSink::OnLogError

name: IDccManSink::OnLogInactive

name: IDccManSink::OnLogListen
